purpose: Recheck the existing read-only municipal-parameters probe after the user reported a real A1 access failure.
observed_discrepancy: The portal still links /API/SefinNacional. The user reported HTTP 404 for that municipal-parameters probe after the TLS compatibility change. Public integration clients use /SefinNacional without /API. The new base still requires a real authenticated check; 404 alone does not prove certificate acceptance or taxpayer eligibility.
